Energy – Congressman Steube Skip To Content 2026 Hurricane Season Resources Energy Domestic energy production is critical to our economy and national security. I am fighting for policies in Congress that reduce dependency on foreign nations, increase domestic energy production, and other means to make energy more affordable for Americans. I oppose the Biden-Harris Administration’s Electric Vehicle mandates and their wasteful taxpayer spending on EV charging infrastructure. Alternative fuel and energy sources can contribute to making our nation energy independent, but it cannot come at the expense of American jobs, Americans’ pocketbooks, or empowering our adversaries and enemies. Veterans – Congressman Steube Skip To Content 2026 Hurricane Season Resources Veterans As a veteran who served in the Army and deployed to Iraq, I am deeply committed to supporting America’s veterans. I’ve spearheaded Congressional reform efforts to provide veterans with health care choices outside of the VA system through my landmark legislation, The Veterans’ True Choice Act. I’ve also led on VA oversight issues in Congress, such as authoring a House-passed amendment to prevent VA employees from working on healthcare claims for illegal immigrants in ICE custody. I’m committed to crafting policies that ensure the VA works for our veterans, not against them. My office actively participates in the Library of Congress Veterans History Project Series, where we document the stories of FL-17’s veteran population for historical preservation. You can learn more about the VHP Project here .
